This implies that the interaction between Phellandral, (R)- and Tumor necrosis factor receptor superfamily member 10B is mediated through UDP-glucuronosyltransferase 2B15 as an intermediate. The observed score of 0.5139 indicates a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, supported by the sequential targeting of the enzymes and their final target. The mechanism highlights the importance of enzyme-mediated pathways in modulating the activity of plant-derived compounds, suggesting that Phellandral, (R)- may exert its biological effects by influencing the expression or function of Tumor necrosis factor receptor superfamily member 10B via this enzymatic cascade.
